label: Ebay

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_mcp** (confidence high). eBay Developers Program (self-serve keys) exposes Browse API search/get item incl. eBay Motors, plus Sell Inventory APIs; eBay publishes an official read-only MCP server (eBay/npm-public-api-mcp).

official_mcp.name: @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp
official_mcp.note: Official local server (npx -y @ebay/npm-public-api-mcp; EBAY_CLIENT_ID/EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET, application or user token); production supports GET (read-only) calls to eBay's REST APIs incl. Buy Browse item search/get.

reason: eBay publishes its own read-only MCP server for its REST APIs (@ebay/npm-public-api-mcp, stdio, https://github.com/eBay/npm-public-api-mcp; GET-only in production), which covers the Buy Browse API item search/get including eBay Motors. No generated server here: developer.ebay.com answers HTTP 403 (bot wall) to plain and headless-Chromium fetches on 2026-09-25, so the Browse API reference could not be re-read first-hand, and mirrors are not used. Use the vendor MCP.
